(4) (a) The Chief Executive Officer of Invest Sri Lanka
shall be appointed by the Economic Commission who also
shall be the Accounting Officer.
(b) The day-to-day management of Invest Sri Lanka shall
be  vested  in  the  Chief  Executive  Officer  and  the  Chief
Executive  Officer  shall  be  responsible  for  implementing
policies and programs and for managing staff and resources.
The qualifications, remuneration, allowances and terms and
conditions  of  employment  of  the  Chief  Executive  Officer
shall be as may be decided by the Invest SL Board from time
to time.
